## Load Libraries 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


## Read in hg19-kc-count.bed and hg16-kc-count.bed
```{r}
header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
df_19kc <- read_tsv('/Users/cmdb/qb26-answers/week1/hg19-kc-count.bed', col_names=header )
df_16kc <- read_tsv('/Users/cmdb/qb26-answers/week1/hg16-kc-count.bed', col_names=header )
```

## Combine the dataframes
```{r}
combined <- bind_rows( hg19=df_19kc, hg16=df_16kc, .id="assembly" )
```


## Visualize both hg19 and hg16 gene distributions on the same line plots
```{r}
p2 <- combined %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = count, color = assembly)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ chr, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome position (Mb)",
       y = "Canonical transcripts per 1 Mb",
       color = "Assembly") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("exercise2.png", plot = p2, width = 14, height = 20, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
